headline: WhatsApp Business Implements API Service Message Fees for Black Friday
summary: WhatsApp Business began charging for service messages on its API starting October 1, prompting cost-reduction strategies for companies ahead of Black Friday.
why: Changes in customer communication API pricing alter operational expenses for e-commerce and retail firms utilizing automated messaging for customer acquisition and support.

impacts.name: Retail and E-commerce
impacts.why: Higher messaging API fees increase marketing and operational overhead expenses for retailers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
